diagnostics.message: Telo.Library/NativeClaimedLib: native[0] ('addon'): path 'native/linux/addon.node' is also named by the controller candidate pkg:telo/local/napi?path=./native/linux/addon.node&os=linux&arch=amd64#Thing on Telo.Definition/Thing. A native file ships only in its platform's native layer and a file extracts from exactly one layer, so publish refuses it — give the native entry its own file, or drop the other declaration.
